title: Property trading
tagline: Buy streets, build houses, trade your way to the top.
teaser: Roll around the board buying property, striking trades and building up your streets while the computer players do the same.

manPage.synopsis: monop — roll, buy, trade and build; outlast the other players.
manPage.description: Ken Arnold’s property-trading board game for BSD, played against the computer.

howToPlay: Roll the dice and move around the board.
Buy streets, then build houses to earn more.
Trade with the computer players and outlast them all.
